paragraphs: R. Menaḥem Talmaya, Kohelet Rabbah at 'When good increases.' R. Ḥananyah and R. Yonatan asked Menaḥem Talmaya. R. Berekhya in R. Yose ben Ḥananyah's name says Menaḥem Talmaya asked them: What is the meaning of 'He afflicted you and made you hungry,' etc.?
